nurse.text: Nah then, duck! Welcome to Hull Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter and I'll sort 'em out.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's a cup of tea and a patty on the side. Don't tell the doctor about the patty.
There you go, right as rain. Which in Hull is most days. Mind the gulls on the way out.
The Ark's in the corner, duck. Same as everywhere, only ours is cream.

else.text: No bother at all. Ta-ra, duck.
